SRPO：长视野推理的自我反思策略优化SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning

Jialong Liu Affiliation: School of artificial intelligence, Wuhan University, Wuhan, China    Yuling Shi Affiliation: School of computer science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China    Ning Yang Affiliation: Institute of automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China    Xiaodong Gu Affiliation: School of computer science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China    Zuchao Li Affiliation: School of artificial intelligence, Wuhan University, Wuhan, China Correspondence to: zcli-charlie@whu.edu.cn
摘要Abstract

自我反思是人类学习中一种强大的学分分配机制， 将稀疏的结果反馈转化为可行的指导。然而，其 培训后大型语言模型 (LLM) 的潜力仍未得到充分开发。 我们提出了自我反思策略优化（SRPO），这是一个框架 内化这种能力。 SRPO 使法学硕士能够分析自己完成的 轨迹，将错误合成为简洁的“反射补丁”，以及 使用反射调节的教师分数来作为密集的令牌级训练信号。 这个过程有效地将稀疏的终端监督转变为密集的、 令牌级学习信号，无需外部批评家，单独 奖励模型，或者更大的教师模型。我们证明 SRPO 实现了 数学推理和长期视野中最先进的性能 具有卓越数据效率的代理基准。使用Qwen3-8B底座 模型中，SRPO 仅使用 8%（0.08Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise ”reflection patches,” and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME’24 using only 8% (0.08×\times）的 规模化监督微调所需的训练 FLOP，同时显着 提高 WebShop (64.7%)、ALFWorld (76.8%) 和 SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%)。代码可在) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available athttps://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO

关键词：Keywords:
训练后、强化学习、自我反思、长视野智能体Post-training, Reinforcement Learning, Self-Reflection, Long-Horizon Agents

1 简介Introduction

后期培训已成为释放大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理和决策能力的关键阶段Post-training has emerged as the critical phase for unlocking the reasoning and decision-making capabilities of large language models (LLMs)(OpenAI et al., 2024; Grattafiori et al., 2024; Shao et al., 2024)。 通过强化学习（RL）与思维链提示等推理时间技术相结合，现代法学硕士在数学推理、代码生成和交互式决策方面取得了令人印象深刻的表现。 然而，一个根本的瓶颈仍然存在：当前的训练后方法很难扩展到. Through reinforcement learning (RL) combined with inference-time techniques such as chain-of-thought prompting, modern LLMs achieve impressive performance on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive decision-making. Yet a fundamental bottleneck remains: current post-training methods scale poorly to长远long-horizon任务——需要在扩展的交互序列中进行连贯推理，并有数十甚至数百个中间决策tasks—those requiring coherent reasoning across extended interaction sequences with dozens or even hundreds of intermediate decisions(Gao et al., 2025; Laban et al., 2025).

根本原因是The root cause is the学分分配问题credit assignment problem在稀疏的监督下。 标准 RL 方法，例如 PPOunder sparse supervision. Standard RL approaches such as PPO(Schulman et al., 2017)和GRPOand GRPO(Shao et al., 2024)无论轨迹长度如何，在整个事件后仅收到终端反馈（成功或失败）。 这仅提供receive only terminal feedback (success or failure) after an entire episode, regardless of trajectory length. This provides merelyO⁡(1)O(1)每集的信息位——导致高方差梯度和样本低效学习的信息瓶颈bits of information per episode—an information bottleneck that leads to high-variance gradients and sample-inefficient learning(Lu and Lab, 2025)。 最近的研究表明，强化学习微调经常会遇到以下问题，这让这一困难变得更加复杂：. Compounding this difficulty, recent studies reveal that RL fine-tuning often suffers from熵崩塌entropy collapse，在没有真正扩大推理能力的情况下逐步缩小政策的探索空间, progressively shrinking the policy’s exploration space without genuinely expanding reasoning capacity(Cui et al., 2025; Yue et al., 2025).

自我反思通过将稀疏的结果信号转换为丰富的文本反馈提供了一种令人信服的替代方案Self-reflection offers a compelling alternative by converting sparse outcome signals into rich textual feedback(Shinn et al., 2023; Madaan et al., 2023)。 该模型不是获得标量奖励，而是分析自身的失败，识别具体错误并生成纠正指导——反映了人类如何通过刻意的反思从经验中学习。然而，现有的反射机制存在根本性的局限性，限制了它们在训练中的实用性。在持续的轨迹中迭代地附加反射会导致语义漂移，累积的上下文最终会因其自身的重量而崩溃. Rather than receiving a scalar reward, the model analyzes its own failures, identifies specific errors, and generates corrective guidance—mirroring how humans learn from experience through deliberate reflection. However, existing reflection mechanisms suffer from fundamental limitations that restrict their utility for training. Iteratively appending reflections within an ongoing trajectory induces semantic drift, where accumulating context eventually collapses under its own weight(Laban et al., 2025)。此外，以冻结参数为条件的反射通常无法有意义地探索解决方案空间，并且注入的反射提示可能会扰乱本地思维过程，产生混乱或过于冗长的输出。. Furthermore, reflections conditioned on frozen parameters often fail to meaningfully explore the solution space, and injected reflection prompts can disrupt native thinking processes, producing chaotic or excessively verbose outputs.

为了弥合基于反思的提示和强化学习之间的差距，我们提出了 SRPO（自我反思策略优化）， 一个将自我反思作为密集奖励生成机制的框架。 我们的核心见解是法学硕士可以作为自己的老师：事后反思 完整的轨迹定义了反射增强的教师分布，通过 教师强制对学生的政策部署进行评分，产生密集的令牌级监督。 至关重要的是，我们引入了一种内存重置机制，该机制将紧凑的反射补丁添加到原始提示符中，并从干净的初始状态重新生成。这种设计保留了任务规范的保真度，同时注入了学习指导，创造了原则上的不对称性——训练时进行反思，推理时不进行——从而推动持续的自我完善。To bridge the gap between reflection-based prompting and reinforcement learning, we propose SRPO (Self-Reflective Policy Optimization), a framework that casts self-reflection as a mechanism for dense reward generation. Our central insight is that an LLM can serve as its own teacher: hindsight reflections on completed trajectories define a reflection-augmented teacher distribution that, via teacher-forced scoring of the student’s on-policy rollouts, yields dense token-level supervision. Crucially, we introduce a reset-with-memory mechanism that prepends compact reflection patches to the original prompt and regenerates from a clean initial state. This design preserves task specification fidelity while injecting learned guidance, creating a principled asymmetry—training with reflection, inference without—that drives continuous self-improvement.

这种反射增强行为通过 on-policy 转移到基础策略中 具有密集代币级监督的蒸馏。稀疏的终端奖励提供的地方This reflection-enhanced behavior is transferred into the base policy through on-policy distillation with dense token-level supervision. Where sparse terminal rewards provideO⁡(1)O(1)每集位数，SRPO 摘录bits per episode, SRPO extractsO⁡(T)O(T)通过计算每个令牌的反向 KL 来计算位 学生分布和反射增强教师分布之间的差异 - 我们称之为的信号bits by computing the per-token reverse KL divergence between the student and the reflection-augmented teacher distributions — a signal we refer to as事后导向的密集监管hindsight-guided dense supervision，因为反射是 观察完整轨迹后生成，并加强对每个令牌的监督，而不是 而不是执行精确的每一步因果归因。这避免了分布偏移 离策略方法所固有的。, since reflections are generated after observing the full trajectory and densify supervision at every token rather than performing precise per-step causal attribution. This avoids the distribution shift inherent in off-policy methods.

总之，这项工作为推进长期发展提供了一个可扩展且有效的框架 推理。我们引入 SRPO 将稀疏结果信号转换为事后引导的密集信号 代币级监管，有效缓解标准情况下的信用分配问题 RL 挣扎。根据经验，SRPO 在数学推理方面取得了最先进的结果 （AIME’24：73.3%）和复杂的代理任务（WebShop、ALFWorld、SWE-Bench-Lite）， 优于反射训练基线（SCoReIn summary, this work presents a scalable and effective framework for advancing long-horizon reasoning. We introduce SRPO to convert sparse outcome signals into hindsight-guided dense token-level supervision, effectively mitigating the credit assignment problem where standard RL struggles. Empirically, SRPO achieves state-of-the-art results on mathematical reasoning (AIME’24: 73.3%) and complex agentic tasks (WebShop, ALFWorld, SWE-Bench-Lite), outperforming reflection-trained baselines (SCoRe(Kumar et al., 2025)，R, R3L (Shi et al., 2026), 崛起, RISE(Qu et al., 2024)）以及来自 72B 外部教师的在策略蒸馏，同时 要求) and on-policy distillation from a 72B external teacher, while requiring∼\sim3.8×3.8\times总 FLOP 次数少于 GRPO（完整第 1 阶段）fewer total FLOPs than GRPO (full Stage 1++2会计）。2 accounting).

2 相关工作Related Work

后培训已成为释放预培训法学硕士推理潜力的标准范例Post-training has become the standard paradigm for unlocking the reasoning potential of pre-trained LLMs(OpenAI et al., 2024; Grattafiori et al., 2024)。主导方法涉及针对语言策略的强化学习 (RL)，其中邻近策略优化 (PPO). The dominant approach involves Reinforcement Learning (RL) over language policies, where Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)(Schulman et al., 2017)以及基于组的变体，例如 GRPOand group-based variants like GRPO(Shao et al., 2024)被广泛用于使模型与人类偏好或客观正确性保持一致。最近，GSPO 等扩展are widely employed to align models with human preferences or objective correctness. Recently, extensions such as GSPO(Zheng et al., 2025)进一步提高了稳定性和样品效率。然而，将强化学习应用于复杂的推理任务并非易事。最近的研究强调了基本的局限性，包括熵崩溃和饱和效应have further improved stability and sample efficiency. However, applying RL to complex reasoning tasks is non-trivial; recent studies highlight fundamental limitations, including entropy collapse and saturation effects(Cui et al., 2025; Yue et al., 2025)，这限制了模型有效探索不同解决方案路径的能力。我们的工作通过超越稀疏的终端奖励来直接解决这些低效率问题。, which restrict the model’s ability to explore diverse solution paths effectively. Our work directly addresses these inefficiencies by moving beyond sparse terminal rewards.

强化学习的挑战在长期代理任务中被放大，这需要对扩展序列进行规划，而不是单轮 QA。最近的基准测试和调查强调了该领域的独特困难，例如指令漂移、上下文管理和随时间推移的错误传播The challenges of RL are amplified in long-horizon agentic tasks, which require planning over extended sequences rather than single-turn QA. Recent benchmarks and surveys emphasize unique difficulties in this domain, such as instruction drift, context management, and error propagation over time(Li et al., 2025; Laban et al., 2025; Deshpande et al., 2025)。而大规模异步强化学习. While large-scale asynchronous RL(Gao et al., 2025)人们提出了系统级优化来处理这些复杂性，但它们通常需要大量的计算资源。与依赖外部知识注入来补充领域空白的方法不同and system-level optimizations have been proposed to handle these complexities, they often demand massive computational resources. Unlike methods that rely on external knowledge injection to supplement domain gaps(Ovadia et al., 2024; Song et al., 2025)，我们的方法侧重于在代理策略内优化推理过程本身，使其能够在多轮交互过程中动态自我纠正。, our approach focuses on optimizing the reasoning process itself within the agent’s policy, enabling it to self-correct dynamically during multi-turn interactions.

为了减少长轨迹中的错误，越来越多的工作利用了模型自身的反射能力。推理时技术，例如 Self-RefineTo mitigate errors in long trajectories, a growing body of work leverages the model’s own reflective capabilities. Inference-time techniques like Self-Refine(Madaan et al., 2023)和反思and Reflexion(Shinn et al., 2023)证明法学硕士可以通过批评自己的成果来改进，有效地将口头反馈视为奖励信号。同样，批评者demonstrate that LLMs can improve by critiquing their own outputs, effectively framing verbal feedback as a reward signal. Similarly, CRITIC(Gou et al., 2024)将此扩展到工具交互设置。虽然很有前途，但这些方法中的大多数仅在推理时运行或依赖于单独的回顾性模块extends this to tool-interactive settings. While promising, most of these methods operate solely at inference time or rely on separate retrospective modules(Yao et al., 2024)。第二项工作将反射转移到训练循环中：SCoRe. A second line of work moves reflection into the training loop: SCoRe(Kumar et al., 2025)使用 RL、RISE（递归内省）训练两轮自我修正策略trains a two-turn self-correction policy with RL, RISE (Recursive Introspection)(Qu et al., 2024)迭代自我改进轨迹的微调，以及 Rfine-tunes on iterative self-improvement trajectories, and R3L (Shi et al., 2026)对反射识别的枢轴标记执行本地修复。这些方法将校正视为加倍计算的推理时间过程（SCoRe 的两轮生成）、单独的监督任务 (RISE) 或局部后缀修复 (Rperforms local repair of pivot tokens identified by reflection. These methods treat correction either as an inference-time procedure that doubles compute (SCoRe’s two-turn generation), as a separate supervised task (RISE), or as a localized suffix repair (R3L）。 SRPO 与所有三个的不同之处在于公开了L). SRPO differs from all three by exposing the满full在每个学生推出的令牌上进行反射增强的教师分布（通过教师强制评分），并通过策略蒸馏将其内部化，以便在推理时不需要反射，并且整个轨迹（而不仅仅是局部枢轴）可以重新路由。我们在第 3 节中将所有三个作为训练时间基线进行比较reflection-augmented teacher distribution at every student-rollout token (via teacher-forced scoring) and internalizing it through on-policy distillation, so that no reflection is needed at inference time and the entire trajectory — not just a local pivot — can be re-routed. We compare against all three as training-time baselines in Section.

我们的框架也与自我蒸馏密切相关，模型从自己的高质量一代中学习Our framework is also closely related to self-distillation, where models learn from their own high-quality generations(Pham et al., 2022; Yang et al., 2024)。虽然标准自蒸馏通常使用离策略数据，但最近的工作强调了在策略蒸馏（从模型的当前分布中学习）的重要性，以提高鲁棒性和一致性. While standard self-distillation typically uses off-policy data, recent work emphasizes the importance of on-policy distillation—learning from the model’s current distribution—to improve robustness and alignment(Agarwal et al., 2024; Patiño et al., 2025)。 SRPO 通过引入一种特定形式的在政策蒸馏来推进这一方向：使用学生在政策部署上的反射条件教师分数作为动态目标。这使得模型不仅可以从正确答案中学习，还可以从纠正自身错误的过程中学习，从而将长视野任务的稀疏信号特征转换为密集的、令牌级的监督。. SRPO advances this direction by introducing a specific form of on-policy distillation: using reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dynamic targets. This allows the model to learn not just from correct answers, but from the process of correcting its own mistakes, thereby converting the sparse signals characteristic of long-horizon tasks into dense, token-level supervision.

3.2 自省政策优化Self-Reflective Policy Optimization

我们提出了 SRPO，这是一个通过自我反射将稀疏结果信号转换为密集的代币级监督的框架，如图 1 所示。核心前提是利用模型自身的反射增强分布作为其基本策略的动态教师。通过教师强制对学生的在策略部署进行评分，将这种自我诱发的教师提炼到学生身上，SRPO 有效地解决了标准训练后范式的局限性：它提供了稀疏奖励 RL 所缺乏的密集监督，减轻了离策略 SFT 固有的暴露偏差，并在不依赖外部教师模型的情况下建立了一个独立的改进循环。 图We present SRPO, a framework that converts sparse outcome signals into dense, token-level supervision via self-reflection, as illustrated in Figure 1. The core premise is to utilize the model’s own reflection-augmented distribution as a dynamic teacher for its base policy. By distilling this self-induced teacher into the student via teacher-forced scoring of the student’s on-policy rollouts, SRPO effectively addresses the limitations of standard post-training paradigms: it provides the dense supervision lacking in sparse-reward RL, mitigates the exposure bias inherent in off-policy SFT, and establishes a self-contained improvement loop without relying on external teacher models. Figure1总结了两阶段 SRPO 流程。summarizes the two-stage SRPO pipeline.

3.2.2 第二阶段：符合政策的自我蒸馏Stage 2: On-Policy Self-Distillation

第二阶段通过策略蒸馏将反射增强行为转移到基本策略中，消除了对显式反射的推理时间依赖。The second stage transfers the reflection-enhanced behavior into the base policy through on-policy distillation, eliminating the inference-time dependency on explicit reflection.

按政策抽样。On-Policy Sampling.对于每个提示For each promptx∼𝒟x\sim\mathcal{D}，我们从当前的学生政策中采样轨迹, we sample trajectories from the current student policyπθ(⋅∣x)\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x)。 与在教师生成的轨迹上进行训练的离策略蒸馏不同，在策略采样可确保学生从实际访问的状态中学习改进，避免因分布偏移而产生的复合错误. Unlike off-policy distillation that trains on teacher-generated trajectories, on-policy sampling ensures the student learns to improve from states it actually visits, avoiding the compounding errors that arise from distribution shift(Ross et al., 2011)。 这在长期环境中尤其重要，因为早期的微小偏差可能会导致下游状态截然不同。. This is particularly crucial in long-horizon settings where small early deviations can lead to drastically different downstream states.

The negative reverse KL rewards tokens that align with the teacher’s distribution while penalizing deviations. Intuitively, tokens receiving high penalty correspond to “forking points” where the student’s choices diverge from the reflection-informed teacher—precisely the decision points where credit assignment is most valuable.

Reverse KL 拥有几个适合我们环境的理想特性： （一）它是Reverse KL possesses several desirable properties for our setting: (i) it is模式寻求mode-seeking，鼓励学生遵循老师偏爱的行为，而不是将概率质量分散到次优的替代方案中； (ii) 它提供了, encouraging the student to commit to the teacher’s preferred behavior rather than spreading probability mass across suboptimal alternatives; (ii) it provides an无法破解的unhackable奖励信号，因为低 KL 总是对应于老师指导下的高概率；和 (iii)它自然地与优化由奖励模型引起的序列级反向KL的策略梯度方法协同作用。reward signal, as low KL always corresponds to high probability under the teacher; and (iii) it naturally synergizes with policy gradient methods that optimize sequence-level reverse KL induced by reward models.

Through this iterative process, the student policyπθ\pi_{\theta}逐渐接近反思增强教师的行为gradually approximates the behavior of the reflection-augmented teacherπT\pi_{T},有效地 内化最初源自反思机制的推理能力。, effectively internalizing the reasoning capabilities initially derived from the reflection mechanism.

SRPO 继承了蒸馏和同策略 RL 的优点：它提供了密集的代币级监督（SRPO inherits the advantages of both distillation and on-policy RL: it provides dense token-level supervision (O⁡(T)O(T)每集比特数对比bits per episode vs.O⁡(1)O(1)对于稀疏强化学习），通过策略采样消除暴露偏差，并且不需要外部教师模型。 反思增强型教师for sparse RL), eliminates exposure bias through on-policy sampling, and requires no external teacher models. The reflection-augmented teacherπT(⋅∣[p;x])\pi_{T}(\cdot\mid[p;x])有效地获得事后信息，创造一种能够自我改进的不对称性：模型学会将最初由结果反馈告知的决策内化。 计算阶段 1 和阶段 2，SRPO 使用effectively has access to hindsight information, creating an asymmetry that enables self-improvement: the model learns to internalize decisions that were originally informed by outcome feedback. Counting Stage 1 and Stage 2, SRPO uses5.4×10185.4\times 10^{18}FLOP 与FLOPs versus20.8×101820.8\times 10^{18}对于 GRPO，即大约for GRPO, i.e., approximately3.8×3.8\times总失败次数更少。 附录中提供了详细的理论分析，包括信息论的观点和自蒸馏机制的形式化处理fewer total FLOPs. 4 实验Experiments

我们根据涵盖数学问题解决和长期代理任务的推理基准来评估 SRPO。 我们与强大的训练后和推理时间基线进行比较，并消除跨模型规模的自我反思和关键设计选择。We evaluate SRPO on reasoning benchmarks spanning mathematical problem-solving and long-horizon agentic tasks. We compare against strong post-training and inference-time baselines, and ablate self-reflection and key design choices across model scales.

4.1 实验装置Experimental Setup

基础模型。Base Models.我们在多个尺度的模型上评估 SRPO 以证明普遍性： Qwen3-1.5B、Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-32BWe evaluate SRPO on models spanning multiple scales to demonstrate generalizability: Qwen3-1.5B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-32B(Yang et al., 2025)作为基础模型。 对于代理任务，我们还对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 进行评估as base models. For agentic tasks, we additionally evaluate on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(Grattafiori et al., 2024)展示跨家庭的泛化能力。to demonstrate cross-family generalization.

    数学推理Mathematical Reasoning：AIME’24（30 个问题，竞赛级别）、MATH-500: AIME’24 (30 problems, competition-level), MATH-500(Lightman et al., 2024)（7 个类别 500 个问题）和 GSM8K(500 problems across 7 categories), and GSM8K(Cobbe et al., 2021)（1,319 道小学数学测试题）。(1,319 test problems) for grade-school math.

  • •

    分布外泛化Out-of-Distribution Generalization：DeepScaleR: DeepScaleR(Luo et al., 2025)包含来自不同领域的 1,200 个具有挑战性的数学推理问题。comprising 1,200 challenging mathematical reasoning problems from diverse domains.

  • •

    长期代理任务Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks: 网上商店: WebShop(Yao et al., 2023)（12,087 个购物任务，成功信号稀疏），ALFWorld(12,087 shopping tasks with sparse success signals), ALFWorld(Shridhar et al., 2021)（134 项家务任务）和 SWE-Bench-Lite(134 household tasks), and SWE-Bench-Lite(Jimenez et al., 2024)（300 个现实世界的 GitHub 问题）。(300 real-world GitHub issues).

培训细节。Training Details.对于数学推理，我们从在 OpenThoughts-3 的 400K 提示上训练的 SFT 检查点进行初始化For mathematical reasoning, we initialize from an SFT checkpoint trained on 400K prompts from OpenThoughts-3(Guha et al., 2025)。 我们使用 256 个 rollouts 的批量大小，学习率为. We use a batch size of 256 rollouts, learning rate of1×10−51\times 10^{-5}具有余弦衰减和削波比with cosine decay, and clip ratioϵ=0.2\epsilon=0.2。 对于代理任务，我们每批次使用 64 个提示进行训练，每个提示有 4 个样本。 所有实验均使用8. For agentic tasks, we train with 64 prompts per batch with 4 samples per prompt. All experiments use 8×\times除非另有说明，否则为 H100 GPU。 反思提示的结构是生成 2-5 个诊断分析要点和可操作的指导。H100 GPUs unless otherwise specified. The reflection prompt is structured to generate 2–5 bullet points of diagnostic analysis and actionable guidance.

基线。Baselines.我们与以下方法进行比较：We compare against the following methods:

  • •

    快速傅里叶变换SFT：对教师生成的轨迹进行监督微调（离策略蒸馏）。: Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories (off-policy distillation).

  • •

    GRPO (Shao et al., 2024)：具有稀疏结果奖励的组相对策略优化。: Group Relative Policy Optimization with sparse outcome rewards.

  • •

    聚苯醚PPO (Schulman et al., 2017)：具有学习值函数的标准 PPO。: Standard PPO with learned value function.

  • •

    符合政策蒸馏 (OPD)On-Policy Distillation (OPD) (Lu and Lab, 2025)：从较大的教师模型（Qwen3-32B: Distillation from a larger teacher model (Qwen3-32B→\rightarrowQwen3-8B）。Qwen3-8B).

  • •

    反思Reflexion (shinn2023reflexionlanguageagentsverbal)：具有记忆积累的迭代反射（仅限推理时间）。: Iterative reflection with memory accumulation (inference-time only).

    自我完善Self-Refine (madaan2023selfrefineiterativerefinementselffeedback)：无需训练的迭代自我完善。: Iterative self-refinement without training.

4.2 主要结果：数学推理Main Results: Mathematical Reasoning

图Figure2展示我们在数学推理基准上的主要结果。 SRPO 在所有四个基准中的表现始终优于所有基准，在 AIME’24 上达到 73.3%，比标准的政策蒸馏提高了 3.3 个百分点，比 GRPO 提高了 5.3 个百分点。 值得注意的是，SRPO 仅用 SFT-2M 外推所需的 8% 的训练 FLOP 就实现了这些增益，展示了卓越的样本效率。presents our main results on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. SRPO consistently outperforms all baselines across all four benchmarks, achieving 73.3% on AIME’24—a 3.3 percentage point improvement over standard on-policy distillation and 5.3 points over GRPO. Notably, SRPO achieves these gains with only 8% of the training FLOPs required by SFT-2M extrapolation, demonstrating superior sample efficiency.

分析。Analysis.SRPO 和标准按策略蒸馏 (OPD) 之间的性能差距凸显了以下价值：The performance gap between SRPO and standard on-policy distillation (OPD) highlights the value of自生的self-generated反射作为教学信号。 OPD 依赖于外部更大的教师模型 (Qwen3-32B)，而 SRPO 使用学生自己的反射条件输出作为目标。 这带来了两个好处：（1）教师的分布与学生的能力边界自然一致，避免了学生难以模仿远远超出其当前能力的行为的“能力差距”问题； (2) 反思机制提供针对特定任务、实例自适应的指导，而不是通用的教师行为。reflection as a teaching signal. While OPD relies on an external, larger teacher model (Qwen3-32B), SRPO uses the student’s own reflection-conditioned outputs as targets. This creates two advantages: (1) the teacher distribution is naturally aligned with the student’s capability frontier, avoiding the “capability gap” problem where students struggle to imitate behaviors far beyond their current ability; (2) the reflection mechanism provides task-specific, instance-adaptive guidance rather than generic teacher behavior.

在分布外泛化 (DeepScaleR) 上，SRPO 显示出较大的相对改进（相对于 OPD 为 +7.8%），这表明反射机制有助于识别和纠正通用蒸馏可能无法解决的特定领域故障模式。On out-of-distribution generalization (DeepScaleR), SRPO shows a larger relative improvement (+7.8% relative to OPD), suggesting that the reflection mechanism helps identify and correct domain-specific failure modes that may not be addressed by generic distillation.

4.3 主要结果：长期代理任务Main Results: Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks

图Figure3呈现长期代理任务的结果。 SRPO 在所有三个基准测试中均取得了最高的成功率：WebShop 上为 64.7%（比 SFT 高出 7.9%）、ALFWorld 上为 76.8%（比 Reflexion 高出 5.6%）、SWE-Bench-Lite 上为 31.2%（比 Reflexion 高出 4.4%）。presents results on long-horizon agentic tasks. SRPO achieves the highest success rates across all three benchmarks: 64.7% on WebShop (+7.9% over SFT), 76.8% on ALFWorld (+5.6% over Reflexion), and 31.2% on SWE-Bench-Lite (+4.4% over Reflexion).

长远视野中的信用分配。Credit Assignment in Long Horizons.SRPO 和基于 RL 的方法（GRPO、PPO）之间的性能差距在这些任务上尤其明显，其中情节可以跨越 10-50 个动作。 强化学习方法难以解决信用分配问题：单个终端成功/失败信号提供的信息不足以确定哪些中间决策至关重要。 相比之下，SRPO 的反射机制明确识别故障模式（例如，“在找到目标对象之前导航到错误的房间”）并将其转换为可操作的指导。The performance gap between SRPO and RL-based methods (GRPO, PPO) is particularly pronounced on these tasks, where episodes can span 10–50 actions. RL methods struggle with credit assignment: a single terminal success/failure signal provides insufficient information to determine which intermediate decisions were critical. In contrast, SRPO’s reflection mechanism explicitly identifies failure modes (e.g., “navigated to wrong room before finding the target object”) and converts them into actionable guidance.

效率提升。Efficiency Gains.有趣的是，SRPO 还实现了最短的平均情节长度（10.2 步），这表明学习的策略不仅更成功而且更高效。 这表明反思提炼的政策已经内化了有效的规划策略，而不是依赖于试错探索。Interestingly, SRPO also achieves the shortest average episode length (10.2 steps), indicating that the learned policy is not only more successful but also more efficient. This suggests that the reflection-distilled policy has internalized effective planning strategies rather than relying on trial-and-error exploration.

4.4 通过自我细化进行推理时间缩放Inference-Time Scaling via Self-Refinement

我们研究了 SRPO 训练模型与推理时间细化策略相结合时的表现。 图We investigate how SRPO-trained models behave when combined with inference-time refinement strategies. Figure4显示推理计算和性能之间的关系。shows the relationship between inference compute and performance.

设置。Setup.我们比较了三种配置：（1）具有迭代自我细化的基本 SFT 模型； (2) GRPO训练的自精炼模型； (3) SRPO 训练的自我细化模型。 对于每种配置，我们将细化迭代次数从 0 更改为 5。We compare three configurations: (1) base SFT model with iterative self-refinement; (2) GRPO-trained model with self-refinement; (3) SRPO-trained model with self-refinement. For each configuration, we vary the number of refinement iterations from 0 to 5.

结果。Results.SRPO 训练的模型表现出卓越的推理时间缩放：每次额外的细化迭代平均提高 1.8%，而 GRPO 为 +1.2%，SFT 为 +0.9%。 经过 3 次迭代，SRPO 在 AIME’24 上达到了 78.5%，接近模型 4 的性能SRPO-trained models exhibit superior inference-time scaling: each additional refinement iteration yields +1.8% improvement on average, compared to +1.2% for GRPO and +0.9% for SFT. At 3 iterations, SRPO achieves 78.5% on AIME’24, approaching the performance of models 4×\times更大。larger.

这种改进的扩展可归因于训练目标：SRPO 明确训练模型以从反射增强上下文中受益。 学习到的策略已经内化了有效反射的结构，并且可以在推理时更有效地利用它们。This improved scaling can be attributed to the training objective: SRPO explicitly trains the model to benefit from reflection-augmented contexts. The learned policy has internalized the structure of effective reflections and can leverage them more efficiently at inference time.

4.5 全面微调与 LoRAFull Fine-Tuning vs. LoRA

图Figure5比较了 SRPO 的完整微调和 LoRA 适应。 我们评估 LoR​​A 的排名为 64 和 128，应用于所有注意力层和 MLP 层。compares full fine-tuning and LoRA adaptation for SRPO. We evaluate LoRA with ranks 64 and 128, applied to all attention and MLP layers.

调查结果。Findings.LoRA-128 在 AIME’24 上实现了 97.8% 的完全微调性能，同时仅使用 1.3% 的可训练参数和 34% 的 GPU 内存。 这种效率使得计算资源有限的从业者可以使用 SRPO。LoRA-128 achieves 97.8% of full fine-tuning performance on AIME’24 while using only 1.3% of the trainable parameters and 34% of the GPU memory. This efficiency makes SRPO accessible for practitioners with limited compute resources.

值得注意的是，与标准 SFT 相比，SRPO 的 LoRA 与完全微调之间的差距更小（如之前的工作所述，LoRA 在大规模训练后滞后了 13%）Notably, the gap between LoRA and full fine-tuning is smaller for SRPO compared to standard SFT (where LoRA lags by 13% after large-scale training, as noted in prior work(Lu and Lab, 2025)）。 我们假设策略蒸馏的密集令牌级监督与低秩更新更兼容，因为它为每个样本提供了更丰富的梯度信息。). We hypothesize that on-policy distillation’s dense token-level supervision is more compatible with low-rank updates, as it provides richer gradient information per sample.

4.6 消融研究Ablation Studies

表Table1提出了消融研究，检查 SRPO 中的关键设计选择。presents ablation studies examining key design choices in SRPO.

反射质量很重要。Reflection Quality Matters.完全删除反思（“直接重试”）会导致 AIME’24 下降 7.5 分，这证实了自我反思提供了超越随机探索的有意义的指导。 有趣的是，超过 10 分的详细反思实际上会损害性能（-3.3 分），这表明过于详细的反思可能会引入噪音或相互矛盾的建议。 这验证了我们对紧凑、可操作反射的设计选择。Removing reflection entirely (“direct retry”) causes a 7.5-point drop on AIME’24, confirming that self-reflection provides meaningful guidance beyond random exploration. Interestingly, verbose reflections with more than 10 points actually hurt performance (-3.3 points), suggesting that overly detailed reflections may introduce noise or conflicting advice. This validates our design choice of compact, actionable reflections.

自生成与外部反射。Self-Generated vs. External Reflection.使用较大的外部教师 (Qwen3-32B) 生成的反射效果比自我反射差（AIME’24 上的 -1.8 分）。 我们将其归因于分布不匹配：外部反射可能会引用学生能力之外的策略或概念，从而导致无效的指导。Using reflections generated by a larger external teacher (Qwen3-32B) performs worse than self-reflection (-1.8 points on AIME’24). We attribute this to distribution mismatch: external reflections may reference strategies or concepts outside the student’s capability, leading to ineffective guidance.

反向KL很关键。Reverse KL is Critical.从反向 KL 切换到正向 KL 会导致 AIME’24 下降 3.9 分。 Forward KL 是“追求平均”，鼓励学生涵盖教师分布的所有模式，从而淡化了对最有效策略的关注。 Reverse KL 的模式搜索特性更符合我们学习教师偏好行为的目标。Switching from reverse KL to forward KL causes a 3.9-point drop on AIME’24. Forward KL is “mean-seeking” and encourages the student to cover all modes of the teacher distribution, which dilutes focus on the most effective strategies. Reverse KL’s mode-seeking property better aligns with our goal of learning the teacher’s preferred behavior.

状态重置至关重要。State Reset is Essential.“无状态重置”配置迭代地附加反射而不重置到初始状态（类似于反射），在 AIME’24 上表现较差 7.0 分。 这证实了我们的假设，即积累的上下文可能会变得不一致并干扰有效的推理。The “no state reset” configuration, which appends reflections iteratively without resetting to the initial state (similar to Reflexion), performs 7.0 points worse on AIME’24. This confirms our hypothesis that accumulated context can become inconsistent and interfere with effective reasoning.

4.8 分析：自生成反射的质量Analysis: Quality of Self-Generated Reflections

为了了解自我反思何时以及为何有所帮助，我们分析了 AIME’24 训练集中的 500 个随机采样的反思实例。To understand when and why self-reflection helps, we analyze 500 randomly sampled reflection instances from the AIME’24 training set.

反思乐于助人。Reflection Helpfulness.我们使用 GPT-4 对每个反思的有用性进行 1-5 级评分（1=不相关，5=可直接采取行动）。 图We use GPT-4 to rate each reflection on a 1–5 scale for helpfulness (1=irrelevant, 5=directly actionable). Figure7（左）显示分布：67% 的反射获得分数(left) shows the distribution: 67% of reflections receive scores≥\geq4，表明模型能够可靠地生成有用的自反馈。 只有 8% 的人获得分数4, indicating that the model can reliably generate useful self-feedback. Only 8% receive scores≤\leq2，通常针对模型缺乏基础知识的问题。2, typically for problems where the model lacks fundamental knowledge.

与改进的相关性。Correlation with Improvement.图Figure7（右）显示出很强的相关性（(right) shows a strong correlation (r=0.72r=0.72）在反思帮助和重新思考推出成功的改进之间。 高质量的反思（得分 5）使成功率平均提高 34%，而低质量的反思（得分 1-2）仅提高 5%——仍然是积极的，但微乎其微。) between reflection helpfulness and improvement in rethinking rollout success. High-quality reflections (score 5) lead to a 34% average improvement in success rate, while low-quality reflections (score 1–2) yield only 5% improvement—still positive but marginal.

失效模式分析。Failure Mode Analysis.我们将不成功的反射分为三种类型： (1)We categorize unsuccessful reflections into three types: (1)一般建议Generic advice(42%)：提供正确但非具体指导的反思（例如，“仔细检查算术”）； (2)(42%): reflections that provide correct but non-specific guidance (e.g., “check the arithmetic carefully”); (2)诊断错误Incorrect diagnosis(35%)：错误识别失败根本原因的反思； (3)(35%): reflections that misidentify the root cause of failure; (3)超越能力Beyond capability(23%)：需要模型不具备的知识的问题。 这些故障模式表明了未来的方向：结合外部验证信号或检索增强反射。(23%): problems requiring knowledge the model does not possess. These failure modes suggest future directions: incorporating external verification signals or retrieval-augmented reflection.

4.9 与较大教师蒸馏的比较Comparison with Larger Teacher Distillation

SRPO 的一个关键优势是消除了对更大教师模型的需求。 表A key advantage of SRPO is eliminating the need for larger teacher models. Table3将 SRPO 与逐渐扩大的教师的蒸馏进行比较。compares SRPO against distillation from progressively larger teachers.

自蒸馏可以匹配或超过较大的教师。Self-Distillation Matches or Exceeds Larger Teachers.值得注意的是，使用 9 时，自蒸馏的 SRPO 优于 Qwen3-72B 的蒸馏（+0.8 分）Remarkably, SRPO with self-distillation outperforms distillation from Qwen3-72B (+0.8 points) while using 9×\times教师失败次数更少。 这表明反射机制有效地“释放”了模型内难以通过传统蒸馏转移的潜在能力。fewer teacher FLOPs. This suggests that the reflection mechanism effectively “unlocks” latent capabilities within the model that are difficult to transfer through conventional distillation.

对从业者的影响。Implications for Practitioners.这一发现具有重大的实际意义：从业者可以改进他们的模型，而无需访问对更大模型的昂贵 API 调用或运行它们的计算资源。 SRPO 通过利用模型自身的功能，实现高质量培训后的民主化。This finding has significant practical implications: practitioners can improve their models without access to expensive API calls to larger models or the computational resources to run them. SRPO democratizes access to high-quality post-training by leveraging the model’s own capabilities.

4.10 持续学习和灾难性遗忘Continual Learning and Catastrophic Forgetting

我们在持续学习的环境中评估 SRPO 的行为，模型必须在不忘记以前技能的情况下获得新的能力。We evaluate SRPO’s behavior in a continual learning setting where models must acquire new capabilities without forgetting previous skills.

设置。Setup.我们首先训练 Qwen3-8B 的数学推理能力，然后适应编码任务 (SWE-Bench-Lite)。 我们衡量新能力的获取和原始数学推理能力的保留。We first train Qwen3-8B on mathematical reasoning, then adapt to coding tasks (SWE-Bench-Lite). We measure both the new capability acquisition and retention of original mathematical reasoning ability.

结果。Results.表Table13结果表明，SRPO 在代码适应后实现了 95.2% 的数学推理性能保留，而 GRPO 为 87.2%，SFT 为 80.3%。 这种保留率的提高可以归因于 SRPO 的在策略学习：通过对模型自身的分布进行训练，SRPO 自然地保持模型已经表现良好的行为。shows that SRPO achieves 95.2% retention of mathematical reasoning performance after code adaptation, compared to 87.2% for GRPO and 80.3% for SFT. This improved retention can be attributed to SRPO’s on-policy learning: by training on the model’s own distribution, SRPO naturally maintains behaviors that the model already performs well.

与之前工作的联系。Connection to Prior Work.这一发现与在政策蒸馏文献中的观察结果一致This finding aligns with observations in the on-policy distillation literature(Lu and Lab, 2025)：在策略方法比离策略方法造成的灾难性遗忘更少，因为它们不会强迫模型模仿分布外行为。: on-policy methods cause less catastrophic forgetting than off-policy approaches because they do not force the model to imitate out-of-distribution behaviors.

5 结论Conclusion

我们提出了 SRPO，这是一种训练后方法，可将情节级别的结果转换为事后指导的密集、反射增强的监督，克服了稀疏奖励 RL 的低效率。这种机制最好不要被理解为自我蒸馏，而是具有反思引导探索的策略强化学习：反思条件下的教师引导学生进入其学习的高回报区域。We presented SRPO, a post-training method that converts episode-level outcomes into hindsight-guided dense, reflection-augmented supervision, overcoming the inefficiency of sparse-reward RL. The mechanism is best understood not as self-distillation but as on-policy RL with reflection-guided exploration: reflection-conditioned teachers steer the student into high-reward regions of its拥有own政策空间 而不是模仿超出其代表性能力的分布。在涵盖数学、代码、代理、科学和逻辑的 10 个基准测试中，SRPO 产生了可重复的收益（多种子引导 CI、policy space rather than imitating a distribution beyond its representational capacity. Across 10 benchmarks spanning math, code, agent, science, and logic, SRPO yields reproducible gains (multi-seed bootstrap CIs,p<0.005p<0.005），匹配或超过较大教师蒸馏，同时要求), matching or exceeding larger-teacher distillation while requiring∼\sim3.8×3.8\times总 FLOP 次数比 GRPO 少，并且在持续学习下自然减轻灾难性遗忘。展望未来，我们的目标是通过外部验证或更好的校准来提高反射质量，并将框架扩展到可验证结果任务之外，包括多模态推理和长期工具使用轨迹。fewer total FLOPs than GRPO and naturally mitigating catastrophic forgetting under continual learning. Moving forward, we aim to refine reflection quality via external verification or better calibration, and to extend the framework beyond verifiable-outcome tasks, including multimodal reasoning and longer-horizon tool-use trajectories.

影响报告Impact Statement

本文提出了一种训练后方法，旨在提高法学硕士中长期推理和代理行为的可靠性和样本效率。 潜在的积极影响包括以更低的计算量和更少的人工标签获得更好的性能，这可以扩大对有能力的模型的访问。 潜在的负面影响包括启用更有效的自主代理，如果部署时没有适当的保障措施，这些代理可能会被滥用（例如，可扩展的网络滥用）。 当将该方法应用于高风险或开放式代理环境时，我们鼓励仔细评估、监控和分阶段发布实践。This paper presents a post-training method intended to improve the reliability and sample efficiency of long-horizon reasoning and agentic behavior in LLMs. Potential positive impacts include better performance with lower compute and fewer human labels, which can broaden access to capable models. Potential negative impacts include enabling more effective autonomous agents that could be misused (e.g., for scalable cyber abuse) if deployed without appropriate safeguards. We encourage careful evaluation, monitoring, and staged release practices when applying the method to high-stakes or open-ended agentic settings.

附录BAppendix B理论见解和计算效率Theoretical Insights and Computational Efficiency

本节提供了 SRPO 的详细理论处理，包括信息论分析、自蒸馏机制的形式论证和计算成本分析。This section provides a detailed theoretical treatment of SRPO, including information-theoretic analysis, formal justification of the self-distillation mechanism, and computational cost analysis.

B.1 信息论视角Information-Theoretic Perspective

我们的方法的效率优势可以通过信息论的视角来理解。 具有稀疏终端奖励的标准强化学习最多提供The efficiency advantage of our approach can be understood through an information-theoretic lens. Standard RL with sparse terminal rewards provides at mostO⁡(1)O(1)每集的监督位——无论轨迹长度如何，模型仅了解最终结果是否成功。 相比之下，具有代币级别 KL 奖励的在策略蒸馏提供了bits of supervision per episode—regardless of trajectory length, the model only learns whether the final outcome was successful. In contrast, on-policy distillation with token-level KL rewards providesO⁡(T)O(T)每集位数，其中bits per episode, whereTT是序列长度。 这个is the sequence length. ThisTT-监督密度的增加直接转化为样本效率的提高：根据经验，基于蒸馏的方法达到了与 10-100 相当的性能-fold increase in supervision density translates directly to improved sample efficiency: empirically, distillation-based methods achieve equivalent performance with 10–100×\times与稀疏奖励强化学习相比，梯度步数更少。fewer gradient steps compared to sparse-reward RL.

SRPO 的一个关键理论动机源于这样的观察：策略自蒸馏本质上规避了现有训练后范式的基本局限性。 与具有稀疏终端奖励的逐点强化学习不同，我们的框架在每个令牌位置提供密集的监督，从而显着提高样本效率。 同时，通过对学生生成的轨迹而不是固定的教师演示进行训练，我们消除了标准 SFT 固有的暴露偏差，并确保模型学会从其自身的分布漂移中恢复。 此外，由于我们的老师只是在反射增强条件下运行的相同模型，因此 SRPO 建立了一个有原则的自我改进循环，不需要访问更大或更强大的外部模型。A key theoretical motivation for SRPO stems from the observation that on-policy self-distillation inherently circumvents the fundamental limitations of existing post-training paradigms. Unlike pointwise RL with sparse terminal rewards, our framework provides dense supervision at every token position, dramatically improving sample efficiency. Simultaneously, by training on student-generated trajectories rather than fixed teacher demonstrations, we eliminate the exposure bias inherent in standard SFT and ensure the model learns to recover from its own distributional drift. Moreover, since our teacher is simply the same model operating under reflection-augmented conditions, SRPO establishes a principled self-improvement loop that requires no access to larger or more capable external models.

B.2 为什么自蒸馏有效Why Self-Distillation Works

一个自然的问题出现了：模型如何充当自己的老师？ 答案在于反射引入的不对称性。 考虑模型在步骤中做出次优决策的轨迹A natural question arises: how can the model serve as its own teacher? The answer lies in the asymmetry introduced by reflection. Consider a trajectory where the model makes a suboptimal decision at stept∗t^{*}。 没有事后诸葛亮，模型一步步. Without hindsight, the model at stept∗t^{*}缺乏有关下游后果的信息。 带反光贴片lacks information about downstream consequences. With reflection patchpp，明确编码结果和诊断，模型在步骤, which explicitly encodes the outcome and diagnosis, the model at stept∗t^{*}有效地获取未来信息——将原本困难的决策转变为更明智的决策。effectively has access to future information—transforming an originally difficult decision into a more informed one.

正式地，让Formally, letI⁡(at∗;o∣st∗)I(a_{t^{*}};o\mid s_{t^{*}})表示给定当前状态的最优行动和结果之间的互信息。 反射补丁使这些信息变得明确：denote the mutual information between the optimal action and the outcome given the current state. The reflection patch makes this information explicit:

I(at∗;o∣st∗,p)≫I(at∗;o∣st∗).I(a_{t^{*}};o\mid s_{t^{*}},p)\gg I(a_{t^{*}};o\mid s_{t^{*}}). (11)

然后，自我蒸馏将这种信息优势转移回无条件政策。 通过迭代训练，学生政策Self-distillation then transfers this information advantage back into the unconditional policy. Through iterative training, the student policyπθ(⋅∣x)\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x)逐渐学会近似的行为gradually learns to approximate the behavior ofπθ(⋅∣[p;x])\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid[p;x])，有效地将原本由显式反思引导的推理模式内化。, effectively internalizing the reasoning patterns that were originally guided by explicit reflection.

B.3 避免退化解决方案Avoiding Degenerate Solutions

一个潜在的担忧是，模型可能会学习微不足道的解决方案，例如完全忽略反射或产生不可泛化的反射。 我们通过几种设计选择来解决这个问题：A potential concern is that the model might learn trivial solutions, such as ignoring the reflection entirely or producing reflections that do not generalize. We address this through several design choices:

  • (一)(i)

    反射已生成The reflection is generated之前before看到重新思考的推出，防止未来代币的信息泄漏。seeing the rethinking rollout, preventing information leakage from future tokens.

  • (二)(ii)

    我们根据不同的提示进行训练，鼓励普遍的反思模式，而不是针对特定提示的记忆。We train on diverse prompts, encouraging generalizable reflection patterns rather than prompt-specific memorization.

  • (三)(iii)

    采样的在策略性质确保模型从实际访问的状态中学习，而不是从理想化的教师轨迹中学习。The on-policy nature of sampling ensures the model learns from states it actually visits, not idealized teacher trajectories.

  • （四）(iv)

    反射补丁的紧凑形式（2-5 个要点）可防止模型简单地记住冗长的解决方案。The compact form of reflection patches (2–5 bullet points) prevents the model from simply memorizing verbose solutions.

经验证据（主论文第 4.3 节）表明，反射可以泛化到各种问题类型，并且即使在推理时移除反射，学习到的策略也能保持强劲的性能。Empirical evidence (Section 4.3 in the main paper) demonstrates that reflections generalize across problem types and that the learned policy maintains strong performance even when reflection is removed at inference time.

B.5 统计方法Statistical Methodology

所有主要论文数字均以 5 个独立种子的平均值报告。 种子在即时洗牌、丢弃掩码和推出的蒙特卡罗采样方面有所不同； SFT-400K 初始化和所有超参数均保持固定。 置信区间是通过对每个实例得分向量进行 10 000 次重采样的配对引导程序获得的；All main-paper numbers are reported as the mean over 5 independent seeds. Seeds differ in prompt shuffling, dropout masks, and Monte-Carlo sampling of rollouts; the SFT-400K initialization and all hyperparameters are held fixed. Confidence intervals are obtained by paired bootstrap over 10 000 resamples of the per-instance score vectors;pp- 报告与 GRPO 和 OPD-32B 进行配对比较的值。 在 AIME’24（30 个问题）上，我们承认小样本量会夸大每个种子的方差，但 SRPO 在 5/5 种子中的表现优于 GRPO，每个实例的增益随机主导了 GRPO 分布（-values are reported for paired comparisons against GRPO and OPD-32B. On AIME’24 (30 problems) we acknowledge that the small sample size inflates per-seed variance, but SRPO outperforms GRPO in 5/5 seeds with the per-instance gain stochastically dominating the GRPO distribution (p<0.005p<0.005）。 在较大的基准测试（MATH-500、GSM8K、WebShop、ALFWorld、LiveCodeBench）上，所有收益均实现). On larger benchmarks (MATH-500, GSM8K, WebShop, ALFWorld, LiveCodeBench) all gains achievep<0.001p<0.001.

附录CAppendix C反射语义控制实验Reflection Semantics Control Experiments

本节提供反射语义控制实验的全面实验细节和扩展分析。这些实验直接解决了这样的担忧：SRPO 的性能提升可能源于额外的上下文标记或教师强制工件，而不是反射的语义内容。This section provides comprehensive experimental details and extended analysis for the reflection semantics control experiments. These experiments directly address the concern that SRPO’s performance gains might stem from additional context tokens or teacher forcing artifacts rather than the semantic content of reflections.

C.1 实验设计Experimental Design

我们设计了一系列受控消融，系统地破坏反射和问题实例之间的语义对齐，同时保留其他因素（格式、令牌计数、训练过程）。We design a series of controlled ablations that systematically disrupt the semantic alignment between reflections and problem instances while preserving other factors (format, token count, training procedure).

反射协议不匹配。Mismatched Reflection Protocol.

对于每个训练批次包含For each training batch containingNN实例instances{(xi,τi,oi)}i=1N\{(x_{i},\tau_{i},o_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N}:

  1. 1.

    正常生成反射补丁：Generate reflection patches normally:pi=Reflect⁡(xi,τi,oi)p_{i}=\mathrm{Reflect}(x_{i},\tau_{i},o_{i})为所有人for allii.

  2. 2.

    对于每个实例For each instanceii, 随机抽样, randomly samplej≠ij\neq i来自同一批。from the same batch.

  3. 3.

    构建不匹配的教师输入：Construct mismatched teacher input:x~imis=[pj;xi]\tilde{x}_{i}^{\text{mis}}=[p_{j};x_{i}].

  4. 4.

    生成教师分布：Generate teacher distribution:πTmis(⋅∣xi):=πθ(⋅∣x~imis)\pi_{T}^{\text{mis}}(\cdot\mid x_{i}):=\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid\tilde{x}_{i}^{\text{mis}}).

该协议确保：（a）不匹配的反射在结构上是有效的（由相同的反射过程生成），（b）令牌长度分布与正确反射的长度分布相匹配，以及（c）唯一的区别是与当前问题的语义相关性。This protocol ensures that: (a) the mismatched reflections are structurally valid (generated by the same reflection process), (b) the token length distribution matches that of correct reflections, and (c) the only difference is the semantic relevance to the current problem.

令牌长度匹配。Token Length Matching.

为了消除不同上下文长度带来的混淆，我们过滤不匹配的对以确保：To eliminate confounds from varying context lengths, we filter mismatched pairs to ensure:

|len​(pj)−len​(pi)|≤0.1⋅len​(pi).\left|\text{len}(p_{j})-\text{len}(p_{i})\right|\leq 0.1\cdot\text{len}(p_{i}). (12)

额外的消融条件。Additional Ablation Conditions.

除了不匹配的反射之外，我们还评估：Beyond mismatched reflections, we evaluate:

  • •

    打乱的单词Shuffled Words：随机排列每个反思句子中的单词，同时保留句子边界。: Randomly permute words within each reflection sentence while preserving sentence boundaries.

  • •

    打乱的句子Shuffled Sentences：随机排列反思中要点/句子的顺序。: Randomly permute the order of bullet points/sentences in the reflection.

  • •

    仅模板Template Only：使用适用于任何问题的固定通用反射：: Use a fixed generic reflection applicable to any problem:

    “• 仔细验证每个计算步骤。• 检查边界条件和边缘情况。• 确保最终答案解决原始问题。”“• Carefully verify each computational step. • Check boundary conditions and edge cases. • Ensure the final answer addresses the original question.”

  • •

    只看结果Outcome Only：用简单的结果指示器替换反思：“之前的尝试是[正确/不正确]。”: Replace reflection with a simple outcome indicator: “Previous attempt was [correct/incorrect].”

语义一致性很重要。Semantic Coherence Matters.

打乱单词和打乱句子条件的表现与不匹配的反射相当，这表明破坏连贯性（即使在最初正确的反射中）会消除大部分好处。这表明该模型并不是简单地提取关键词，而是依赖于连贯的推理结构。Shuffled-words and shuffled-sentences conditions perform comparably to mismatched reflections, indicating that disrupting coherence—even within originally correct reflections—eliminates most of the benefit. This suggests the model does not simply extract keywords but relies on the coherent reasoning structure.

特定于任务的信息。Task-Specific Information.

我们将反思内容分为四类：We classify reflection content into four categories:

  • •

  • •

图Figure9(d) 显示匹配的反射在 78-91% 的情况下包含与任务相关的信息，而不匹配的反射中的相同内容仅在 8-15% 的情况下（偶然）与实际问题相关。这解释了性能差距：不匹配的反射提供了模型必须学会忽略的不相关的“噪声”。(d) shows that matched reflections contain task-relevant information in 78–91% of cases, while the same content in mismatched reflections is relevant to the actual problem only 8–15% of the time (by chance). This explains the performance gap: mismatched reflections provide irrelevant “noise” that the model must learn to ignore.

图Figure9(c) 显示不同条件下的训练曲线。主要观察结果：(c) shows training curves for different conditions. Key observations:

通过语义对齐实现更快的收敛。Faster Convergence with Semantic Alignment.

匹配反射在大约 250 次迭代中达到 70% 的准确度，而不匹配和无反射条件则需要Matched reflections achieve 70% accuracy in approximately 250 iterations, while mismatched and no-reflection conditions require>>500 次迭代达到较低水平的稳定状态（500 iterations to plateau at a lower level (∼\sim66%）。这表明语义相关的反射提供了更强、更一致的训练信号。66%). This suggests that semantically relevant reflections provide a stronger and more consistent training signal.

无后期恢复。No Late-Stage Recovery.

不匹配的条件无法“赶上”扩展训练，这证实了性能差距不是由于学习速度较慢而是由于训练信号质量的根本限制。The mismatched condition does not “catch up” with extended training, confirming that the performance gap is not due to slower learning but fundamental limitations in the training signal quality.

C.5 影响和结论Implications and Conclusions

这些实验为以下主张提供了有力的证据：These experiments provide strong evidence for the following claims:

  1. 1.

    语义内容至关重要Semantic content is essential：SRPO 的性能提升主要取决于反射内容和特定问题实例之间的语义一致性。: Performance gains from SRPO depend critically on the semantic alignment between reflection content and the specific problem instance.

  2. 2.

    格式和标记不足Format and tokens are insufficient：匹配反射的格式、风格和代币数量并不会带来利益转移；只有与任务相关的语义内容才能产生改进。: Matching the format, style, and token count of reflections does not transfer benefits; only task-relevant semantic content produces improvements.

  3. 3.

    反思支持学分分配Reflections enable credit assignment：语义对齐反射的有效性表明它们通过突出决策点和错误源成功地执行了“软信用分配”，否则这些决策点和错误源很难从稀疏的终端反馈中识别出来。: The effectiveness of semantically aligned reflections suggests they successfully perform “soft credit assignment” by highlighting decision points and error sources that would otherwise be difficult to identify from sparse terminal feedback.

  4. 4.

    没有老师强迫工件No teacher forcing artifacts：不匹配的反射的失败排除了基于教师强制规范化或接触“未来信息”的解释——如果这种机制是负责任的，那么不匹配的反射应该提供类似的好处。: The failure of mismatched reflections rules out explanations based on teacher forcing regularization or exposure to “future information”—if such mechanisms were responsible, mismatched reflections should provide similar benefits.

这些发现直接解决了审稿人的担忧，即 SRPO 的收益可能源于“仅添加更多文本”，并为有关反射蒸馏管道中信息流的理论主张提供了实验基础。These findings directly address the reviewer concern that SRPO’s gains might stem from “just adding more text” and provide experimental grounding for the theoretical claims about information flow in the reflection-distillation pipeline.

附录EAppendix E持续学习和灾难性遗忘Continual Learning and Catastrophic Forgetting

我们在持续学习的环境中评估 SRPO 的行为，模型必须在不忘记以前技能的情况下获得新的能力。We evaluate SRPO’s behavior in a continual learning setting where models must acquire new capabilities without forgetting previous skills.

设置。Setup.我们首先训练 Qwen3-8B 的数学推理能力，然后适应编码任务 (SWE-Bench-Lite)。 我们衡量新能力的获取和原始数学推理能力的保留。We first train Qwen3-8B on mathematical reasoning, then adapt to coding tasks (SWE-Bench-Lite). We measure both the new capability acquisition and retention of original mathematical reasoning ability.

结果。Results.表Table13结果表明，SRPO 在代码适应后实现了 95.2% 的数学推理性能保留，而 GRPO 为 87.2%，SFT 为 80.3%。 这种保留率的提高可以归因于 SRPO 的在策略学习：通过对模型自身的分布进行训练，SRPO 自然地保持模型已经表现良好的行为。shows that SRPO achieves 95.2% retention of mathematical reasoning performance after code adaptation, compared to 87.2% for GRPO and 80.3% for SFT. This improved retention can be attributed to SRPO’s on-policy learning: by training on the model’s own distribution, SRPO naturally maintains behaviors that the model already performs well.

与之前工作的联系。Connection to Prior Work.这一发现与在政策蒸馏文献中的观察结果一致This finding aligns with observations in the on-policy distillation literature(Lu and Lab, 2025)：在策略方法比离策略方法造成的灾难性遗忘更少，因为它们不会强迫模型模仿分布外行为。: on-policy methods cause less catastrophic forgetting than off-policy approaches because they do not force the model to imitate out-of-distribution behaviors.
